newsitem.title: UK: SkyePharma ups "black box" sales estimate.
newsitem.headline: SkyePharma ups "black box" sales estimate.

text.p: British-based SkyePharma Plc said on Tuesday that it had doubled its own estimate of expected sales for proprietary "black box" drugs under development for major pharmaceutical companies.

SkyePharma said the "black box" projects using its Geomatrix oral drug delivery technologies had potential annual sales of more than $5.0 billion. The company forecast potential sales of $2.5 billion when it floated.
"Black box" drugs refer to products developed in secrecy, usually for third parties. Analysts say all the "black box" products at SkyePharma are being funded by other companies.
